backup_id.description: Required. The ID of the backup to restore from.
backup_id.rationale: This identifies the backup source but is not itself a generic explicit security control.

backup_vault_id.description: Required. The ID of the backup vault.
backup_vault_id.rationale: This is a resource reference rather than a generic explicit security control.

clear_overrides_field_mask.description: Optional. A field mask used to clear server-side default values during restore.
clear_overrides_field_mask.rationale: This is operational restore behavior, not a generic explicit security control.

data_source_id.description: Required. The ID of the data source.
data_source_id.rationale: This is a resource reference rather than a generic explicit security control.

delete_restored_instance.description:
Optional. If true (default), running terraform destroy will delete the live resource in GCP.
If false, only the restore record is removed from the state, leaving the resource active.
delete_restored_instance.rationale: This is a clear generic safeguard because disabling automatic deletion reduces the risk of unintentionally removing restored resources during destroy operations.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

location.description: Required. The location for the backup vault.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

name.description: The resource name of the backup instance.
name.rationale: This is deprecated and acts as an identifier rather than a security control.

request_id.description:
Optional. An optional request ID to identify requests. Specify a unique request ID
so that if you must retry your request, the server will know to ignore
the request if it has already been completed.
request_id.rationale: This is an idempotency and request-tracking field, not a generic explicit security control.
